reason: ₹1,999 every month for a year is too much when we earn barely ₹13,000 a month and every rupee is going to the wedding and the children's fees. My wife washes by hand now, so this is a want, not a need, this year.
objection: Even the EMI is too heavy for us right now, and I am not sure a cold-water semi-automatic will get the mud and sweat out of field clothes, so we may end up scrubbing by hand anyway.
would_change_my_mind: An EMI under ₹800 a month, or seeing a neighbour's machine clean real muddy farm clothes on battery.
